title: Monumental ridgelines
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Wide 16:9 original bitmap page environment for a restrained academic personal website.
Primary request: Monumental layered sage and celadon mountain ridgelines, cream illuminated slopes, rendered with a fine but clearly visible terminal-glyph / ASCII halftone computational landscape texture.
Composition: The LEFT 60% of the entire canvas must be perfectly clean, flat, neutral almost-white paper #F7F8F4 for web text. The BOTTOM 12% of the entire canvas must be clean flat same paper, with a seamless flat bottom edge. All detailed colored forms occupy the RIGHT 38%. These are immense landscape layers dramatically cropped by and continuing BEYOND THE RIGHT EDGE and TOP RIGHT EDGE; not an isolated floating object. Use dramatically scaled tall ridgeline strata with crisp depth, coherent terrain shapes and strong celadon/sage color in the rightmost region. Let sparse terminal glyphs on terrain's leftmost boundary naturally meet the paper, without a fuzzy blurred or enclosed boundary. Keep every terrain contour above the bottom clean paper band.
Palette: Neutral #F7F8F4 page ground, muted sage/celadon ridges, buttercream illuminated slopes, rich dusty teal details, narrow restrained palette. No overall green wash; white paper dominates.
Style: Computational landscape, exact tiny monospaced abstract terminal glyph marks in a fine regular halftone matrix describe strong tangible mountain contours and dimensional layers. Organic terrain silhouettes at monumental scale, scholarly calm with rich detail. The art must have actual crisp depth and shape, not barely visible haze.
Lighting: Cream side light on ridges with dimensional muted teal shadows.
Constraints: No clouds, text, readable words, lettering, logo, frame, oval, circle, vignette, card, mockup, interface, isolated object, border, cast shadow around artwork, gradient behind artwork, foggy boundary, or all-over green. Fill to top-right and right edges to create a PAGE ENVIRONMENT. Left 60% and bottom 12% perfectly clean flat #F7F8F4 paper.
assessment: Crisp dimensional glyph terrain reaches top and right edges. Leftmost 38–40% is entirely clear; foreground slopes intrude into the requested left 60%. Bottom approximately 13% is clean paper but terrain ends in a visible straight horizontal cutoff. No pixel modifications performed.
